summary: Banco Bradesco filed a 6-K reporting that Brazil's Central Bank approved a previously announced capital increase via subscription of new shares, first disclosed July 29, 2026, with shareholder notices on September 16 and September 30, 2026. Subscribed shares will be issued and credited October 13, 2026. The September 30 board-declared interest on shareholders' equity of R$3.8bn now reflects the new share count, adjusted to R$0.323858718 per common and R$0.356244590 per preferred share, net R$0.267183442 and R$0.293901787 after 17.5% withholding tax; payment expected by April 30, 2027. Watch share-count dilution and payout mechanics.
